The main idea is that a skip_connect on edge 3 (0→3) gives a direct residual path from input to output. That path makes other edges' contributions less critical. If edge 3 is none, accuracy depends entirely on the multi-hop paths through nodes 1 and 2. Edits that add or remove convolutions on those paths should then matter more, in either direction.
